titleEn: Kitchen Renovation Cost Breakdown Vancouver 2026: Every Line Item Explained
titleZh: 温哥华厨房装修费用明细2026：逐项解析每一分钱去向
contentEn:
A kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026 can cost anywhere from $35,000 to $200,000 or more. Behind that range is a specific combination of decisions: the size of your cabinets, the grade of your countertop material, whether you are moving plumbing, and how much of your existing infrastructure needs replacing. Reno Stars has completed more than 200 kitchen projects across Metro Vancouver. This guide breaks down what each line item actually costs and why, so you can build a realistic budget before you sign a contract.

Cabinetry: $12,000–$45,000 (30–40% of total budget)

Cabinetry is almost always the single largest line item in a Vancouver kitchen renovation. For a typical 10×12-foot kitchen, custom solid-wood cabinets run $25,000–$45,000. Semi-custom options cost $15,000–$28,000. Refacing — keeping the cabinet boxes and replacing only the doors and hardware — typically runs $8,000–$15,000. Thermofoil or laminate cabinet packages start around $5,000 but rarely survive more than eight to ten years in a Vancouver home without warping, due to humidity fluctuations between the coast and the inland valleys.

Countertops: $3,000–$18,000

Countertops are priced per square foot including fabrication and installation. Laminate remains the most affordable option at $40–$80 per square foot installed. Quartz — the most popular material in Metro Vancouver kitchens — typically costs $150–$300 per square foot. Natural stone such as granite or marble runs $200–$500 per square foot. For a typical 30-square-foot countertop section, expect $4,500–$9,000 for quartz. A full-slab stone backsplash adds $1,200–$4,000 more.

  • Laminate: $40–$80 / sqft installed
  • Quartz: $150–$300 / sqft installed
  • Granite / Marble: $200–$500 / sqft installed
  • Butcher block: $80–$150 / sqft installed

Electrical and Plumbing Changes: $3,000–$20,000

Moving any plumbing fixture — a sink, dishwasher, or gas cooktop — adds $2,000–$8,000 per fixture in rework. Homes built before 1990 in Vancouver typically have 100-amp electrical service. Upgrading to 200-amp for a new kitchen runs $3,000–$8,000 as a standalone job. Adding circuits for an induction cooktop or wine fridge adds $500–$1,500 per circuit. These costs are easy to underestimate; always ask your contractor for an electrical assessment before finalising your budget.

Flooring: $2,000–$8,000

Kitchen flooring in Vancouver homes typically uses engineered hardwood ($8–$14 per square foot installed), luxury vinyl plank ($5–$12 per square foot), or large-format porcelain tile ($12–$22 per square foot). For a 120-square-foot kitchen, flooring material and installation totals $1,800–$5,000 depending on material choice.

Permits: $1,200–$3,500

Most kitchen renovations in Vancouver proper require a building permit, especially if structural walls, electrical panels, or plumbing rough-ins are involved. Permit fees in the City of Vancouver are calculated on the project value at roughly $18 per $1,000 of construction cost, with a minimum of $1,200. Burnaby, Richmond, and Coquitlam charge on similar scales. Strata approvals for condominiums add another $300–$800 in application fees and may restrict construction hours to weekdays 8:00 am–5:00 pm.

Labour and General Conditions: 35–50% of Material Cost

In Metro Vancouver, labour typically runs 35–50% of the material cost for a mid-range kitchen renovation. For a $50,000 material package, expect $17,500–$25,000 in labour. Reno Stars maintains consistent crews across Metro Vancouver projects, which eliminates the markup that general contractors pass on for sourcing unfamiliar sub-trades in different municipalities.

Contingency: 15–20% of Total Budget

Every renovation encounters surprises once walls are opened. Common finds in Vancouver homes: outdated wiring not to code, asbestos in floor tiles in homes built before 1990, rot in sill plates on ground-floor kitchens. A 15% contingency on a $75,000 project equals $11,250 — typically enough to cover whatever surfaces.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a basic kitchen renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A basic kitchen refresh — new cabinet doors, laminate or quartz countertop, fresh paint, and new hardware — typically costs $34,500 to $38,000 in Metro Vancouver in 2026. This assumes a standard 120-square-foot kitchen and does not include moving any plumbing or electrical fixtures.

What is the biggest line item in a kitchen renovation?

Cabinetry typically accounts for 30–40 percent of the total kitchen renovation budget. For a mid-range project, that means $18,000–$30,000 of a $60,000–$80,000 total, depending on whether you choose custom, semi-custom, or refaced cabinets.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

You need a building permit in Vancouver if your renovation involves moving plumbing fixtures, altering structural walls, or upgrading your electrical panel. Cosmetic work such as refacing cabinets, replacing countertops, and painting does not require a permit. Permit fees in the City of Vancouver run roughly $18 per $1,000 of project value.

How long does a mid-range kitchen renovation take in Metro Vancouver?

A mid-range kitchen renovation — custom cabinets, new flooring, minor layout changes, and updated electrical — typically requires 6–10 weeks of active construction. Permit processing in Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond adds another 4–8 weeks before work begins.

What contingency should I budget for a kitchen renovation?

Plan for a 15–20 percent contingency fund. For a $75,000 kitchen project, that means setting aside $11,250–$15,000 for surprises uncovered once walls are opened — outdated wiring, asbestos in floor tiles, or rot in structural members are all common finds in Vancouver homes built before 1990.

2026年大温哥华地区的厨房装修费用从$3.5万到$20万加元以上不等。费用背后是一系列具体的决定：橱柜的尺寸、台面材料的等级、是否需要移动水管，以及现有基础设施需要更换多少。Reno Stars已在大温地区完成超过200个厨房项目。本文逐项解析每一项费用的实际去向，帮助您在签约前建立准确的预算。

橱柜：$12,000–$45,000（占总预算30–40%）

橱柜通常是温哥华厨房装修中最大的单项。对于一个典型的10×12英尺厨房，定制实木橱柜的价格为$25,000–$45,000。半定制选项费用为$15,000–$28,000。翻新橱柜——保留箱体只更换门板和硬件——通常在$8,000–$15,000之间。热压板或层压板橱柜套餐起步约$5,000，但由于沿海与内陆山谷之间的湿度波动，在温哥华住宅中通常撑不过八到十年就会出现翘曲。

计划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？获取Reno Stars的免费、无义务报价。

台面：$3,000–$18,000

台面按平方英尺计价，含制造和安装。层压板是最实惠的选择，含安装约每平方英尺$40–$80。石英石——大温哥华厨房最受欢迎的材料——通常每平方英尺$150–$300。花岗岩或大理石等天然石材每平方英尺$200–$500。对于一个典型30平方英尺的台面区域，石英石费用约为$4,500–$9,000。整板石材背板需额外增加约$1,200–$4,000。

  • 层压板：含安装每平方英尺$40–$80
  • 石英石：含安装每平方英尺$150–$300
  • 花岗岩/大理石：含安装每平方英尺$200–$500
  • 砧板台面：每平方英尺$80–$150

水电改造：$3,000–$20,000

移动任何水管装置——水槽、洗碗机或煤气灶——每件设备增加$2,000–$8,000的改造费用。1990年前建的温哥华房屋通常只有100安培的电力服务。升级到200安培通常需要$3,000–$8,000。为电磁炉或酒柜增加电路，每个回路需额外$500–$1,500。这些费用容易被低估；在最终确定预算之前，务必让您的承包商进行电气评估。

地板：$2,000–$8,000

温哥华住宅的厨房地板通常使用工程实木（每平方英尺含安装$8–$14）、豪华乙烯基地板（每平方英尺$5–$12）或大规格瓷砖（每平方英尺$12–$22）。对于一个120平方英尺的厨房，地板材料和安装总费用因材料不同在$1,800–$5,000之间。

许可证：$1,200–$3,500

温哥华市的大多数厨房装修都需要建筑许可证，特别是涉及结构墙、电气面板或管道粗装时。温哥华市的许可证费用按项目价值的每$1,000约$18计算，最低$1,200。本拿比、列治文和高贵林的收费大致相同。公寓的物业审批需额外支付$300–$800的申请费，并可能将施工时间限制在工作日上午8点至下午5点。

人工和综合费用：材料成本的35–50%

在大温哥华，人工通常占中档厨房装修材料成本的35–50%。对于$50,000的材料包，人工约为$17,500–$25,000。Reno Stars在大温地区各城市维持稳定的工作团队，无需为不熟悉该地区的分包商支付额外费用。

应急资金：总预算的15–20%

每次装修在墙壁打开后都会遇到意外情况。温哥华住宅的常见发现：不符合规范的旧线路、1990年前建造房屋地板瓷砖中的石棉、一楼厨房窗台板的腐朽等。$75,000项目中15%的应急资金等于$11,250——通常足以覆盖任何意外。

常见问题

2026年温哥华基础厨房装修多少钱？

基础厨房翻新——新橱柜门板、石英石或层压板台面、新油漆和新硬件——在2026年大温哥华地区通常费用为$34,500至$38,000。这假设为标准120平方英尺厨房，且不包括移动任何水管或电气装置。

厨房装修中最大的单项费用是什么？

橱柜通常占总厨房装修预算的30–40%。对于一个中档项目，这意味着$60,000–$80,000总预算中的$18,000–$30,000，取决于您选择定制、半定制还是翻新橱柜。

温哥华厨房装修需要许可证吗？

如果您的装修涉及移动水管装置、改造结构墙或升级电气面板，则需要建筑许可证。翻新橱柜、更换台面和油漆等 cosmetic 工程不需要许可证。温哥华市的许可证费用按项目价值的每$1,000约$18计算。

大温哥华中档厨房装修需要多长时间？

中档厨房装修——定制橱柜、新地板、轻微布局变更和更新电气——通常需要6至10周的 active 施工。温哥华、本拿比和列治文的许可证审批在开工前还需额外4至8周。

厨房装修应该预留多少应急资金？

计划预留15–20%的应急资金。对于$75,000的厨房项目，这意味着预留$11,250–$15,000用于墙壁打开后发现的意外情况——不符合规范的旧线路、1990年前房屋地板中的石棉或结构构件的腐朽，都是温哥华老旧住宅中的常见发现。
